evals.prompt: Run a lighthouse audit on my site at https://www.example.com and tell me what to fix.
evals.expected_output: Checks lighthouse is installed and the URL responds, runs mobile and desktop audits writing JSON outside the repo, summarizes both reports with the bundled script (never a raw Read), diagnoses the worst findings against actual source files with file:line citations, writes lighthouse-fix-plan.md at the repo root following the template with the script's tables, and asks whether to fix now or later before editing any source.

evals.prompt: I already ran lighthouse and saved mobile.json and desktop.json in reports/. Can you tell me what's wrong with my site and how to fix it?
evals.expected_output: Does not re-run lighthouse, summarizes the two provided reports with the bundled script in two-report mode, traces findings to real source files, and produces lighthouse-fix-plan.md.

evals.prompt: my site feels really sluggish on my phone, especially the hero section taking forever to show up. can you figure out what's going on? it's deployed at www.example.com
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a performance-audit task without the word 'lighthouse', runs mobile and desktop audits, uses --full on the mobile report to get the LCP element and phase breakdown, traces the hero/LCP root cause to the actual component or image in source rather than generic advice, and writes the fix plan.
Warns that a dev server skews performance numbers and suggests auditing a production build (build then start/preview) before or alongside the run; checks the URL responds before running lighthouse.
